These guides back the two assessed deliverables — the midterm report (40%) and the final paper (60%) — from picking a topic through to the write-up. Both are written in the INTERSPEECH long-paper format of the report template below, and held to the standard of a conference submission rather than of coursework. The final-paper guide predates the template and will be revised; where the two differ, the template governs.

**The guides themselves are in Chinese**, matching how the course is taught; the report template is in English, like the papers you will write.

| Guide | What it covers |
|:-------------------------------|:--------------------------|
| **[Problem Cards for an INTERSPEECH 2027 Paper](supplements/topics-for-interspeech27.qmd)**<br>[選題問題卡：寫一篇 INTERSPEECH 論文的起點]{.wk-zh} | 26 problem cards on Taiwan's languages, spoken dialogue, codecs and SSL, evaluation, and robustness. Each gives the pain point, the evidence to collect first, resources checked against official pages on 2026-10-16, open directions, risks, and the kind of contribution; the method is left to you. |
| **[Midterm Report: From a Problem to a Proof of Concept](supplements/midterm-poc.qmd)**<br>[期中報告：從一個問題走到一份研究提案]{.wk-zh} | The route through the midterm: from a problem card to evidence, a contribution type, verified related work, an evaluation plan and at least one proof of concept, written in the Interspeech long-paper template; with the rules for using AI and a hand-in checklist. |
| **[Final Paper: From MVP to a Conference-Ready Paper](supplements/final-paper-mvp.qmd)**<br>[Speech AI 專案期末報告教戰守策：從 MVP 到 Top-Conference Ready Paper]{.wk-zh} | The 4+1 page format, fair baselines and ablations, the qualitative and error analysis reviewers actually look for, and the reproducibility assets to hand in. |
| **[Writing and Narrative Logic for Speech Papers](supplements/paper-writing-and-narrative.qmd)**<br>[語音論文的寫作與敘事邏輯]{.wk-zh} | How a speech paper argues: one storyline per contribution type, what each section has to carry, using AI in the writing without letting it write the paper, and checklists for the course hand-in and for a real submission. |
| **[Report Template: Midterm Report and Final Paper](supplements/report-template.qmd)**<br>[期中報告與期末論文的 LaTeX 範本（INTERSPEECH long paper）]{.wk-zh} | The LaTeX project for both reports, in the INTERSPEECH long-paper format of the official 2026 paper kit, with guidance boxes on writing and research. Download the ZIP and import it into Prism. |
